items.difficulty_reason: 44 行（含 17 行陈述）、Frobenius 线性映射的 Coker 消没 + Ker 构造性：n 元 n 方程的显示代数 A'（dx_i 微分为零⇒非分歧、n 生 n 关系⇒整体相对完全交叉⇒平坦⇒étale）、忠实平坦由先前 Frobenius 引理锚定、预像显式给出；Ker 由显示的商表示化概形代表、affine étale ⇒ constructible。软点披露：'A computation shows'（dx_i 为零的微分计算未展示，为显示方程的直接求导）与 'the reader can show'（忠实平坦的直接核验，但有具名引理锚定）。无 verbatim omit。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-frobenius-linear-on-vb (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4429-4445

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: reduce to the affine free case; for surjectivity of F - 1 it suffices to work after a faithfully flat etale extension: the displayed algebra A' cut out by n equations in n variables has vanishing differentials (unramified), is a global relative complete intersection (flat), hence etale, and is faithfully flat by the earlier Frobenius lemma; the tautological element maps onto the given one; for the kernel, the displayed quotient presentation shows Ker(F - 1) is represented by a scheme affine etale over S, giving constructibility by the etale shriek constructibility lemma (source lines 4451-4494)
